name: comp-449
title: Breadcrumb With Icons
description: A flat breadcrumb row pairing a house outline with Home and a small blocks glyph with Components, before a brighter current-page label.
use: Showing a page's place in a short hierarchy with quick links back up the levels.
avoid: When the path is long: only two links plus the current page are set up here.
a11y: Icons are hidden from screen readers and each link keeps its text name; focus styling falls back to the browser. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three short labels sit in a row on black, the first preceded by a house outline and the second by a small blocks glyph, with faint chevrons between. The final label Breadcrumb reads brighter than the two links.
behaves: Hovering a link lifts its text and icon from grey to white while the row stays fixed. Nothing else changes.
customise: The three labels and their icons are fixed in the file; a real path means editing the items and swapping the icon imports.
weight: light: Three text links and two small icons; no script, loop or animation.
demo: Home, Components and Breadcrumb with house and block icons.
polishWhy: Crisp spacing and a legible hierarchy, but a plain breadcrumb with icons added.
